messages:
maya: Thinking about adding a sampling slider to the per-route heatmap in Console — users run full-dense heatmaps and blow up telemetry costs. can we offer a quick sample-rate preview and a saved-query param?

alex: agree. UX should make the cost tradeoff explicit. show estimated rows scanned / token cost next to slider. :money_with_wings:

sam: backend note — we shouldn't run on-the-fly full-resolution queries for high-card routes. two options: 1) pre-aggregated heatmap endpoint (1m buckets by default) or 2) cheap sampled scan with reservoir sampling. both need query params.

kevin: for rollouts we need parity between sampled view and full metrics. can't have sampled heatmap hide regressions. suggest toggles: "preview (sampled)" vs "accurate (async job)" with a warning for >100M events.

eva: saved queries should persist the sampling knob and window. when someone pins a view -> store sample_rate and bucket_size. also UI should expose a small legend explaining sampling bias.

maya: proposed API contract: GET /api/v1/routes/{route_id}/heatmap?sample=0.05&window=6h&bucket=5m -> returns {buckets, sampled:true, sample_rate:0.05}. keep shape stable so Console can switch client-side.

alex: +1. also add header X-Query-Estimate: "rows:123k, cost:0.02" so Console can show cost before executing.

sam: implementation detail: if sample < 0.01 we fallback to precomputed summary to avoid tail variance. will need a freshness TTL on precomputed tiles.

kevin: telemetry-bot: can we track when users switch sample vs accurate? we need to detect "false negatives" during canaries.

telemetry-bot: logged event: heatmap_view.mode (sampled|accurate), heatmap_view.sample_rate, heatmap_view.route_id, user_id_hash. retention 90d by default.

eva: UX: add a small inline "Cost & accuracy" badge next to saved query name. also allow admins to lock max sample on org-level to prevent huge scans.

maya: quick mock: slider on the right, preview pane shows lower-res heatmap in <1s with sample tooltip, a link "Run accurate job" which spins up async job and posts to notifications when ready.

alex: keep in mind quotas. accurate jobs should consume from a separate quota bucket (long_jobs) so we don't kill interactive throughput. tickets: quota design + API header + Console badge.

sam: I'll draft the service change: add /heatmap endpoint with sample param, add precomputed-tiles service, and a job endpoint POST /routes/{id}/heatmap/jobs to request accurate aggregation.

maya: action items:
- sam: design API + fallback logic (ETA Tue)
- alex: quota header + cost estimate header (ETA Wed)
- eva: UI mock & saved-query persistence (ETA Thu)
- kevin: define rollout parity checks for sampled mode (ETA Fri)

maya: thanks everyone — let's try to keep the initial sample slider conservative (min 0.01). we'll iterate after some usage data. :+1:
